mutations.name: archived ids are reported as unknown
kills: lintEdges does not report a dep on an archived task in another initiative

mutations.name: every slug reports the cycle
kills: lintEdges reports a two-initiative dep cycle once, naming its ids in order

mutations.name: unknown parent is not reported
mutations.find: return `task ${id} ${error.field} ${error.ref} is not a known task id`;
mutations.replace: return error.field === 'parent' ? null : `task ${id} ${error.field} ${error.ref} is not a known task id`;
kills: lintEdges reports an unknown parent id
